method: Built-in image generation; generated PNGs converted to optimized WebP with browser canvas encoding
interpretationNote: Original generated fan illustrations and reused Azerothium research assets. Clothing, scene composition, terrain, lighting and architecture are interpretive, not canonical model captures or surveyed layouts. Every TBC area needs human side-by-side comparison before approval. Environmental references describe recognizable area language, not claims that this artwork exactly reconstructs the game.

Costume and expression are interpretive, not canonical model evidence.
